programme.title: My Cat From Hell: Philly's Forgotten Cats
programme.desc: Jackson faces one of his greatest challenges when an old friend enlists his help he is asked to put on a mass trapping event and recruit a new generation of volunteers to save community cats in Philadelphia.

programme.title: I Was Prey: Silent Scream
programme.desc: A polar bear chases down Erin Greene as she walks home from a Halloween party in a small arctic town a bull shark attacks triathlete Chuck Anderson in the Gulf of Mexico, biting his arm and pulling him to the ocean floor.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Big Day for Baby Rhino
programme.desc: Terri helps prepare the zoo's new baby rhino, Carrie, to receive a lifesaving vaccine Robert is on a rescue mission to save two black swans in very bad shape Bindi tries to determine if a cranky wombat named Poa might be pregnant.

programme.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Top Cats
programme.desc: Tom is called out to Olympia on a late night rescue mission neighborhood dog chases large indoor cat, Earl, high up on a tree and doesn't exactly let Tom rescue him Play-Play needs rescuing in La Conner.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R.
programme.desc: From rhino saviors and lion researchers to savvy entrepreneurs and armed security teams, Ivan tours the front lines of conservation to meet the individuals who are reshaping and protecting wild Africa. Ivan journeys to four separate countries.

programme.title: Phelps vs Shark: Great Gold vs Great White
programme.desc: See what happens when the world's fastest human swimmer, Olympic icon Michael Phelps, competes against one of the fastest predators on the planet, the shark, in the ultimate race.

programme.title: The Zoo: Taming of the Shrew
programme.desc: Cardiologists try to determine why the geladas are experiencing a life-threatening heart condition Nile crocodiles are shifted off exhibit for a maintenance project the elephant shrews are breeding.

programme.title: My Cat From Hell: Meow Mates
programme.desc: Jackson guides a defeated couple and their cat who has been locked away for over a year he visits a Cat-Ambassador who works with his guardian to help special needs cats find forever homes Jackson visits an incredible prison program.

programme.title: I Was Prey: Invisible Assassin
programme.desc: Diver Tim Saxon films underwater at the Great Barrier Reef and gets stung by an Irukandji jellyfish, one of the world's most venomous animals a grizzly bear attacks forester George Knoll in the remote Great Bear Rainforest.
